name: File Existence
description: GitHub Action to check for file existence

files.description: Comma separated string with paths to files and directories to check for existence.

ignore_case.description: Ignore if a file has upper or lower cases.

follow_symbolic_links.description: Indicates whether to follow symbolic links.

fail.description: Makes the Action fail on missing files.

allow_failure.description: This variable is deprecated in favour of "fail".
